note: KNOWN-GOOD WebR package list. EVERY entry was PROVEN by actually running the package in real WebR (probe via the headless-WebR harness) - never guessed. Consult this BEFORE choosing a package for a lesson, so you pick a compatible one up front instead of finding out at verify-time. The per-lesson runner Scripts/verify_lesson_webr.mjs is the final ground truth for a lesson's actual code; this is the fast lookup the gate + /write-lesson use. To add a package: PROBE it once and record the evidence here. Statuses: runnable = runs and gives real output (live ```r block); runnable_no_visual = runs without error but its rich HTML/widget output does NOT render in WebR (use ```r for the data/text, show the visual as a static image, or ```r-static); illustrative = library loads but the lesson's real use needs a server / API key / network (use ```r-static); incompatible = errors in WebR (switch package or ```r-static).
webr_repo_size: ~21,600 CRAN packages compiled to WASM at repo.r-wasm.org; most pure-R and many compiled packages work. Likely-bad (not yet needed, probe before use): GPU stacks (torch, tensorflow, keras), Java-backed (rJava and dependents), and anything needing a live system service. Servers/APIs load but cannot run their core use (see 'illustrative').

Attach with suppressMessages(library(cluster)) to keep the attach output out of captureR

kernlab.evidence: gausspr(y ~ x, kernel='rbfdot', kpar=list(sigma=...), var=...) fits a GP regression and predict() returns real values in WebR (probed 2026-07-02 via verify_lesson_webr.mjs). Gotchas: gausspr scales inputs AND y by default, so convert the lengthscale (l / sd(x)) and noise var (var / var(y)) to scaled units; rbfdot sigma = 1/(2 l^2); predict(type='sdeviation') output is mis-scaled, compute bands by hand

pscl.evidence: zeroinfl(y ~ x | z, dist='poisson') and hurdle(...) both fit and summary()/coef()/predict(type='prob')/AIC/vuong work in WebR (probed 2026-07-02 via verify_lesson_webr.mjs)

quantmod.evidence: library(quantmod) attaches in WebR and its OFFLINE functions run on a locally-built xts: the OHLC accessors Op()/Hi()/Lo()/Cl()/HLC() and Delt() all return real values (probed 2026-07-17 via verify_lesson_webr.mjs on simulated intraday bars). Attach with suppressMessages(library(quantmod)): the plain attach emits a 'Registered S3 method overwritten by quantmod: as.zoo.data.frame' message that breaks captureR.
quantmod.gotcha: getSymbols() does NOT work in WebR - it needs a live network fetch (Yahoo/FRED) and returns no data in the browser sandbox (probed 2026-07-17: getSymbols('AAPL', src='yahoo') returned no usable xts). Show any getSymbols call as a ```r-static run-locally block and build the data inline for live blocks. ROC() also crashes WebR ('null function') because it calls lag() on the xts internally - see the xts gotcha; use Delt() instead.

robustbase.evidence: lmrob() MM-estimator fits and weights(., type='robustness') work in WebR (probed 2026-07-02 via verify_lesson_webr.mjs)

Rtsne.evidence: Rtsne(as.matrix(unique(iris[,1:4])), perplexity=25) runs to completion and returns a real 149x2 embedding $Y in WebR (probed 2026-07-07 via verify_lesson_webr.mjs). Rtsne needs no duplicate rows (pass unique() or check_duplicates=FALSE) and perplexity must satisfy 3*perplexity < nrow-1. The Barnes-Hut C++ core compiles to WASM and runs; t-SNE is stochastic, so set.seed for reproducibility and do not assert exact coordinate #> output (verifier only checks for errors).

sandwich.evidence: vcovHC(fit, type='HC1') and NeweyWest(fit, lag, prewhite=FALSE) build heteroskedasticity- and HAC-consistent covariance matrices that coeftest() reads in WebR (probed 2026-07-07 via verify_lesson_webr.mjs).

shiny.evidence: library loads but an app cannot serve inside WebR - show app code as ```r-static

tseries.evidence: adf.test() and kpss.test() run in WebR and reproduce local R 4.6.0 values EXACTLY (probed 2026-07-17 via verify_lesson_webr.mjs with stopifnot assertions on the published numbers: adf.test(AirPassengers) stat -7.3186 / p 0.01, kpss.test(AirPassengers) stat 2.7395, kpss.test(AirPassengers, null='Trend') stat 0.09615, plus set.seed(42) rnorm/cumsum and set.seed(11) arima.sim chains - all matched). Attach with suppressMessages(library(tseries)): the plain attach emits a 'Registered S3 method overwritten by quantmod' message. Note both tests warn 'p-value smaller/greater than printed p-value' when the statistic falls outside the interpolation table; that is normal, not an error.
tseries.gotcha: tseries::adf.test ALWAYS fits a constant AND a linear trend, so its alternative is trend-stationary, not level-stationary. Pair it with kpss.test(null='Trend') when comparing verdicts, or the two tests look like they disagree when they do not.

tsibble.evidence: library(tsibble) loads; as_tsibble()/tsibble()/yearmonth()/filter_index() build and print a real tsibble in WebR (probed 2026-07-21 via verify_lesson_webr.mjs).

tsibbledata.evidence: Data-only package; data(aus_retail) loads a 64k-row keyed tsibble and feeds a multi-key fable model()/forecast() pipeline in WebR (probed 2026-07-21 via verify_lesson_webr.mjs).

umap.evidence: library(umap) fails to load in WebR: its namespace imports reticulate (Python) even for the pure-R 'naive' method, and reticulate is unavailable in WASM (probed 2026-07-07). Use ```r-static for UMAP; teach live embeddings with Rtsne instead.

urca.evidence: library(urca) loads and ur.kpss(x, type='mu') returns a real test statistic + critical-value table in WebR (probed 2026-07-17 via verify_lesson_webr.mjs). It is also pulled in as a forecast dependency, which is how forecast::ndiffs(test='kpss') works live.

uwot.evidence: library(uwot) ERRORS in WebR: 'there is no package called uwot' - not in the repo.r-wasm.org WASM repo (probed 2026-07-07). Show UMAP via uwot::umap() as a ```r-static run-locally block.

vars.evidence: library(vars) loads in WebR and the full VAR workflow runs live (probed 2026-07-22 via verify_lesson_webr.mjs): VAR(Canada, p=2, type='const'), VARselect, serial.test (Portmanteau), causality (Granger + instant), irf(boot=TRUE, runs=20), fevd, and predict(n.ahead) all returned real numeric results. Pulls MASS/strucchange/urca/lmtest/sandwich, which install cleanly from repo.r-wasm.org.

xts.evidence: xts(data, order.by=POSIXct) constructs, and the intraday workhorses all run in WebR on 390 one-minute bars, matching local R 4.6.0 exactly (probed 2026-07-17 via verify_lesson_webr.mjs): date-string subsetting x['2026-03-02 09:30/2026-03-02 10:00'] and time-of-day subsetting x['T09:30/T09:35'], to.period(k=5, OHLC=TRUE), endpoints(on='minutes', k=30), period.apply(), align.time(), periodicity(), tzone(), index(), merge(), na.locf(), and rollapply(). Attach with suppressMessages(library(xts)) to keep the zoo attach message out of captureR.
xts.gotcha: diff() and lag() on an xts object CRASH WebR with a JS-level 'null function' error (not a catchable R condition - try() does not save you); quantmod's ROC() fails the same way because it calls lag() internally. Probed 2026-07-17. Workaround for live blocks: drop to the numeric vector and re-wrap, e.g. xts(c(NA, diff(as.numeric(x$price))), order.by=index(x)), or use quantmod::Delt() for returns. diff()/lag() on a plain zoo or numeric vector are fine.

tsoutliers.evidence: library(tsoutliers) loads and tso(y, types=c('AO','LS','TC')) runs the full Chen-Liu detection loop in WebR on a 60-point monthly ts (probed 2026-07-22 via verify_lesson_webr.mjs). WebR ships tsoutliers 0.6.10 / forecast 9.0.2 / R 4.6.0, identical to local R 4.6.0, so #> outputs match byte for byte.
tsoutliers.gotcha: tso() is an iterative ARIMA search: keep the series short (<= ~150 points) and pass maxit.iloop/maxit.oloop or a fixed tsmethod so a live block returns in a few seconds.

anomalize.evidence: library(anomalize) loads; the full time_decompose(method='stl') |> anomalize(method='iqr'|'gesd') |> time_recompose() pipeline runs on a 180-row daily tibble in WebR (probed 2026-07-22 via verify_lesson_webr.mjs). WebR ships anomalize 0.3.0 / dplyr 1.2.1, identical to local R 4.6.0.
anomalize.gotcha: anomalize needs a tibble/data.frame with a Date or POSIXct index column, not a ts object. Attach with suppressPackageStartupMessages() to keep the startup banner out of captureR.

changepoint.evidence: probed 2026-07-22 via Scripts/verify_lesson_webr.mjs: library(changepoint) + cpt.mean(method="PELT") + cpts() + param.est() all executed in real WebR (exit 0)
